field.label: Show Extension Directory Tip
field.comment: Shows a short panel on the admin dashboard that points administrators with full access to the Mage-OS Extension Directory (System > Extensions). The panel's own "Hide this tip" button turns this off as well.

field.label: Mode
field.comment: Direct: admin browsers load the UI bundle and the catalog feed straight from the directory host, which needs the CSP whitelist shipped with this module and CORS on that host. Proxy: this store's server fetches and caches the feed and serves the copy of the UI bundle that ships with this module, so the page is fully same-origin — for restricted networks or privacy-sensitive admins.
